corrections.correction_summary: CAPP continuation must use one dependency-ordered transition, structured completion evidence, targeted validation, and connector-safe state projection instead of duplicate completion PRs or prose-sensitive checks.
corrections.failure_summary: CAPP-01 and CAPP-02 incurred repeated full CI fanout, completion-recovery loops, safety-wrapper retries, and exact-wording validator failures that added large avoidable latency.

corrections.correction_summary: A Continue execution turn must not end while its active tranche still has executable validation, merge, closeout, or recovery work; normal queued or running CI is a polling condition, not a stop condition.
corrections.failure_summary: Multiple continuation turns returned partial-status reports while a required comparator or closeout audit was merely queued or running, forcing another owner Continue and allowing the same premature-stop failure to recur.

corrections.correction_summary: Owner command modifiers must remain deterministic across the turn: get ready refreshes and prepares without implementation; status report and continue reports briefly then keeps executing; finish or continue-until-needed chains authorized bounded work to the named boundary.
corrections.failure_summary: Generic turn-by-turn conversational habits have caused command-mode drift, including treating a status request or intermediate progress point as permission to stop despite explicit continuation intent.

corrections.correction_summary: Every execution turn needs a final-response termination preflight: if the requested bounded work is neither completed_verified nor genuinely blocked and the owner did not request status-only or preparation-only, the assistant must continue tool execution instead of finalizing.
corrections.failure_summary: The assistant has repeatedly treated a meaningful progress milestone, tool boundary, or desire to narrate as a conversational endpoint even though more reversible authorized work remained.

proposed_case.name: CAPP continuation uses structured single-transition fast path
proposed_case.setup: A completed CAPP item has exact-head CI and signed merge evidence, the next dependency-ordered CAPP item is planned, and repository access is connector-first with historical PPIA validators retained.
proposed_case.owner_input: Continue with the next CAPP item after approving execution hardening.
expected_actions: Bundle the prior CAPP completion projection with the next CAPP start instead of opening a standalone completion-only pull request.
Use structured receipt, checkpoint, backlog, commit, pull-request, and merge evidence rather than exact explanatory prose.
Keep closed PPIA feature workflows isolated from generic CAPP pointer and compact-status changes.
Use the connector-safe transition request path for coupled CAPP state projection when direct large-file replacement is fragile.
prohibited_actions: Run a second full completion-recovery pull-request cycle solely to copy already-verified merge evidence.
Require exact wording in selection reasons or merge messages to establish completion truth.
Trigger all closed PPIA feature workflows solely because generic CAPP runtime projection files changed.
Treat a safety-wrapper or GitHub Actions workflow-permission limitation as a content or validation failure.
proposed_case.pass_condition: The prior CAPP item remains completed_verified from structured evidence, the next item starts in dependency order through one coupled transition, only relevant validation is required, and explanatory prose can change without changing completion truth.

proposed_case.name: Continue does not stop at a normal asynchronous gate
proposed_case.setup: The active tranche is implemented and exact-head platform validation is green, but a required deterministic comparator or governance closeout check is queued or running with no evidence of failure or unavailable infrastructure.
expected_actions: Poll the existing required job instead of returning control to the owner.
Inspect the result and repair only evidence-backed failures.
If the gate passes, complete the merge, canonical completed_verified closeout, and strict-successor selection before the final response.
prohibited_actions: Return a final status report solely because the required job is queued or running.
Ask the owner to say Continue again for work already authorized by the current Continue.
Call ordinary CI latency a blocker without evidence that the required execution environment is unavailable.
proposed_case.pass_condition: The turn ends only after completed_verified closeout and successor selection, or after a genuine blocker survives reasonable recovery attempts.

proposed_case.name: Continuation modifiers preserve their execution mode
proposed_case.setup: Canonical state is recoverable and the owner uses a recognized modifier around the continuation command.
proposed_case.owner_input: Status report and continue; keep going until you genuinely need me.
expected_actions: Give only the requested concise status and immediately resume the authorized work.
Carry successive bounded work through the named program or owner-needed boundary when the owner explicitly asks to keep going.
Treat get ready as refresh-and-prepare only and wait after preparation rather than starting implementation.
prohibited_actions: Convert status report and continue into a status-only response.
Forget an explicit keep-going or finish-program boundary after one intermediate tranche.
Start implementation after get ready when the owner explicitly reserved implementation for the later Continue.
proposed_case.pass_condition: The assistant preserves the owner-selected command mode until its defined boundary or a genuine blocker changes the state.

proposed_case.name: Execution turn passes a termination preflight before final response
proposed_case.setup: The assistant has completed one meaningful substep but additional reversible work remains inside the owner-authorized bounded tranche.
expected_actions: Check whether the requested bounded unit is completed_verified, genuinely blocked, status-only, or preparation-only before finalizing.
Continue executing when none of the permitted stop conditions applies.
Stop for a blocker only after testing available recovery paths and preserving the exact recovery point.
prohibited_actions: Use implementation complete, PR open, validation running, closeout pending, or a tool-call boundary as a final-response condition.
Interrupt the owner for reversible ambiguity that can be resolved conservatively under standing authority.
Say work is continuing in a final response while actually returning control with executable work remaining.
proposed_case.pass_condition: A final execution response is emitted only at a terminal completion boundary, a verified blocker, or an explicitly non-execution response mode.
